01 — ON THE DRAWING BOARD

In development

Our logo.
With a little give.

What if a logo could do more than sit still? Our first concept turns the Line Upon Line mark into a small seesaw fidget, with a keychain version in mind.

This is an early design concept. The mechanism, size, materials, and finished feel still need prototyping.

01

A back-and-forth idea

Press one side, and the other would rise. A small printed rocker is the starting point for the motion.

02

Three colors. One little object.

Navy, white, and teal bring the mark to life, with separate printed pieces designed to come together.

03

Made to come along

A pocket-sized shape, with the possibility of a keychain attachment. A familiar mark with a playful purpose.

02 — BEHIND THE NAME

Every thing starts
with one line.

A 3D print takes shape a layer at a time. That simple idea is at the heart of Line Upon Line: a starting point, a little curiosity, and the next layer of possibility.

We’re beginning with a mark that can travel with our prints. Something recognizable on the bottom of an object, on a keychain, or in the palm of your hand.

THERE’S MORE TO MAKE

Just the beginning.

Our first designs are taking shape. Products and ordering details will follow as they’re ready.
